overview.primary_goal: Create a highly memorable, technically impressive portfolio that authentically represents John's identity as a mathematician while balancing scholarly gravitas with playful intellectualism. The site must stand out from generic academic portfolios through creative Gothic architectural integration, sophisticated animations, and interactive mathematical elements.

pillar.name: Mathematical Minimalist
pillar.description: High-contrast, euclidean clarity emphasizing mathematical precision. Clean lines, purposeful negative space, and rigorous visual hierarchy.

pillar.name: Gothic Structural Framework
pillar.description: Gothic arches form the literal structure of the website. Section dividers as decorative tracery, card containers with ogive frames, navigation within cusped arch frames, and architectural elements integrated into functional UI components.

pillar.name: Dark Academia Atmosphere
pillar.description: Inspired by the Trinity College Long Room library - warm wood tones, scholarly depth, classical learning environment with modern mathematical rigor. Atmosphere of late-night study sessions, discovery, and intellectual pursuit.

technical_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS with custom design tokens

micro_interactions.philosophy: Every interaction should feel weighted and intentional, as if manipulating physical objects in an ancient library. Buttons have mechanical resistance, pages turn with momentum, elements respond to physics.

interaction.name: double-click-chalk-dust
interaction.effect: Burst of 20-40 chalk dust particles from click point. Particles use Physics2D for realistic drift with slight upward bias. Color: rgba(245,245,240,0.6), fade over 1.5 seconds.

interaction.name: gothic-tracery-symbol-reveal
interaction.effect: Hidden mathematical symbols fade into view within Gothic tracery patterns. Examples: Euler's identity in quatrefoil, golden ratio in spiral, infinity in arches.
interaction.css: .tracery-symbol { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.8); filter: blur(4px); transition: all 400ms ease-out 200ms; } .tracery-reveal:hover .tracery-symbol { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); filter: blur(0); }

interaction.name: typewriter-button-depress
interaction.effect: Button physically depresses like typewriter key: - translateY(3px) on mousedown with shadow reduction - Spring back on mouseup with slight overshoot

interaction.name: page-transition-weight
interaction.effect: Pages feel like heavy manuscript pages turning: - Current content slides out with deceleration (weighted feel) - New content slides in with overshoot then settle - Gothic arch mask clips transition edges
interaction.gsap_timeline: timeline.to(currentPage, { x: "-5%", opacity: 0.3, scale: 0.98, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.in" }) .fromTo(newPage, { x: "5%", opacity: 0 }, { x: "0%", opacity: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.out" }, "-=0.2");

interaction.name: card-elevation-shadows
interaction.effect: Cards cast realistic shadows responding to elevation: - Shadow expands and softens as card "rises" - translateY(-4px) completes elevation illusion - Shadow offset shifts as if light source is fixed
interaction.css: .card { box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); transition: box-shadow var(--transition-base), transform var(--transition-spring); } .card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-hover); transform: translateY(-4px); }

interaction.name: mobile-shake-clear
interaction.effect: Shaking clears chalkboard with eraser sweep animation. Shake threshold: 15 (acceleration delta). Eraser SVG sweeps left to right, dust cloud follows.

interaction.name: loading-proof-animation
interaction.trigger: Page load, route changes, async loading
interaction.effect: Loading states show famous proofs writing themselves: Random selection from library, chalk SVG path animation.

agent.hagoromo_chalk_3d:
Geometry: CylinderGeometry - radiusTop: 0.4, radiusBottom: 0.35, height: 3.5 - radialSegments: 16 - Tip: Chamfered/worn at writing end
Material: MeshStandardMaterial - color: #F8F8F4, roughness: 0.9, metalness: 0 - normalMap: Subtle chalk surface texture
Animation behavior: - Floating: Hovers 5-8px above surface, subtle rotation wobble (±3°) - Writing: Follows bezier paths, 30-45° angle, variable speed, pressure variation - Completion: Arc to ledge, settle with slight bounce, lay flat (1.5s)
agent.writing_system:
Chalkboard: #1A1A1A with slate texture at 5% opacity, 16:9 aspect ratio Ledge: Bottom 8%, wooden with chalk dust accumulation
Path processing: 1. Load SVG path for selected theorem 2. Parse into drawable segments 3. Calculate path length and duration 4. Animate chalk position along path with GSAP 5. Draw chalk brush at each frame 6. Spawn dust particles at writing point
Timing: - Base speed: 100px/second - Ease in at stroke start, ease out at end - Pause between strokes: 200-400ms - Pause between characters: 100-200ms
agent.theorem_library: euler_identity: e^{iπ} + 1 = 0 (8s) - "Most beautiful equation" pythagorean: a² + b² = c² (6s) - "Foundation of geometry" quadratic: x = (-b ± √(b²-4ac))/2a (12s) - "Quadratic formula" gaussian: ∫_{-∞}^{∞} e^{-x²} dx = √π (15s) - "Gaussian integral" cauchy: f(a) = (1/2πi) ∮_γ f(z)/(z-a) dz (18s) - "Complex analysis" fundamental_calculus: d/dx ∫_a^x f(t)dt = f(x) (14s)
agent.validation: - 3D chalk renders correctly in Three.js - Chalk follows writing paths accurately - Chalk brush creates realistic texture - Writing speed feels natural - Dust particles drift convincingly - Settling animation feels physical - Random theorem selection works - 60fps performance maintained

creative_directives.principle: Never default to standard UI patterns. Every element should feel specifically designed for a mathematician's portfolio. Card catalog over hamburger menu. Journal volumes over simple lists. Chalk brush over basic drawing tools.
Interactions should feel physical. Buttons depress like keys. Pages turn with weight. Cards cast real shadows. Particles drift and settle. Use GSAP Physics2D and InertiaPlugin to achieve this.
Reward exploration with Easter eggs. Mathematical symbols hidden in Gothic tracery. Different theorems on each page load. Details that only observant visitors will discover.
Balance gravitas with playfulness. The site should feel like a serious mathematician's workspace that happens to be delightfully designed. Professional content, whimsical presentation.

Gothic elements should be architecturally informed, not superficially applied. Understand lancet arches, trefoils, quatrefoils, tracery, and use them structurally as real Gothic architects would - as functional frames and supports, not mere decoration.

The site should embody the elegance mathematicians see in their work. Clean proofs. Elegant solutions. The beauty of e^iπ + 1 = 0. Every design decision should resonate with someone who appreciates mathematical aesthetics.
